_note: One line per scene of the cut, sized to that scene's footage (about 150 words a minute). Cards: title, how, evidence, end; q_* lines play over the opening teaser. Claims match results/RESULTS.md; everything shown is simulated. zh_subtitles: Chinese subtitle text for the same scenes (not voiced).

en.title: Joon Rui runs TulBrew, thirty tea shops in Shenzhen, and wants a first shop in Singapore.
en.q_pay: And how can he pay for it legally, without disadvantaging the shops at home?
en.sign_in: Waypoint is an interactive chat inside the WeBank app that walks him through five short steps.
en.consent: First, Joon Rui lets Waypoint read the WeBank business accounts: sales, cash, payroll and loan repayments.
en.profile_typed: That fills in most of the profile, and a first card sums up the business: margin, trend and cash runway. For the rest, one typed sentence: customers, budget, and when to open.
en.site: Waypoint ranks Singapore's fifty-five planning areas using public data. Joon Rui taps an area, then a unit. Each unit shows the cups a day it needs to break even, which here is more than even the best shop at home sells.
en.cost: The startup cost comes with a likely figure and a bad case. A contractor's quote is read line by line, hidden instructions ignored and personal details blurred. Then a payback card: this shop only pays back inside its three-year lease above about three hundred and thirty cups a day.
en.slider: Now the biggest lever: how much monthly profit to set aside. The opening date and the risk to home cash move together, any share that risks the home shops is locked, and the funding plans sit side by side.
en.guard: Can he just use his WeBank loan for the deposit? No. Waypoint shows the rule and its legal source, what WeBank can do at home instead, and the lawful routes.
en.goal_plan: Every step comes in the order the law requires. Nothing will start until Joon Rui approves.
en.goal_tab: His goal now has its own tab: the opening date, his current savings against the plan, and next steps.
en.goal_keeper: Next the Goal Keeper takes over. Each week, it checks the real numbers against the plan. Four shops have a sales dip, and four weeks later it is flagged; the same company without the dip raises no alert. Waypoint offers fixes, each with new dates. He picks one and approves. He stays in control.
en.email: Alerts and monthly check-ins arrive by email, with no amounts unless he asks for them.
en.how: Under the hood, the AI only writes the words. Code computes every number and enforces every rule, and the owner approves every step. Waypoint never moves money.
en.evidence: It's tested end to end, against goals we set before testing. Forged approvals were never accepted, and poisoned quotes never changed the approval card or added a recipient.
en.end: Waypoint, by Tul dot py. A shop abroad, planned in one conversation, and kept on track.

zh_subtitles.title: Joon Rui 经营 TulBrew，在深圳有三十家茶饮店，想在新加坡开第一家门店。
zh_subtitles.q_pay: 又该怎样合法筹钱，而不影响国内的门店？
zh_subtitles.sign_in: Waypoint 是微众银行 App 里的互动对话，带他走完五个简短的步骤。
zh_subtitles.consent: 首先，Joon Rui 授权 Waypoint 读取微众企业账户：销售、现金、工资和还款。
zh_subtitles.profile_typed: 大部分资料自动填好，第一张卡片概括了生意：利润率、走势和现金可支撑月数。剩下的只需一句话：客群、预算和开业时间。
zh_subtitles.site: Waypoint 用公开数据为新加坡五十五个规划区打分。Joon Rui 选定区域和铺位。每个铺位都显示保本所需的日杯量——这里甚至高于国内最好门店的销量。
zh_subtitles.cost: 开店成本给出可能值和最坏情况。装修报价逐行读取，忽略暗藏指令，遮盖个人信息。接着是回本卡片：这家店日销约三百三十杯以上，才能在三年租期内回本。
zh_subtitles.slider: 接下来是最大的杠杆：每月拿出多少利润来储蓄。开业日期和国内现金风险同步变化，会危及国内门店的比例会被锁定，各个资金方案并排对比。
zh_subtitles.guard: 能不能直接用微众贷款付押金？不行。Waypoint 列出规则及其法律依据、微众在国内能提供的支持，以及合法的途径。
zh_subtitles.goal_plan: 每一步都按法律要求的顺序排列。在 Joon Rui 批准之前，什么都不会开始。
zh_subtitles.goal_tab: 他的目标有了专属页面：开业日期、当前储蓄与计划的对比，以及接下来的步骤。
zh_subtitles.goal_keeper: 接着由目标守护接手。每周把实际数字与计划对比。四家门店销售下滑，四周后被标记出来；没有下滑的同一家公司不会触发提醒。Waypoint 提供修复方案，每个都附新日期。他选定一个并批准。主动权始终在他手里。
zh_subtitles.email: 提醒和每月复盘通过邮件发送；除非他要求，不显示金额。
zh_subtitles.how: 在底层，AI 只负责文字。每个数字都由代码计算，每条规则都由代码执行，每一步都由老板批准。Waypoint 从不动用资金。
zh_subtitles.evidence: 我们进行了端到端测试，测试目标在测试前就已设定。伪造的批准从未被接受；被篡改的报价单也从未改变批准卡片，或添加收款人。
zh_subtitles.end: Waypoint，由 Tul.py 打造。一次对话规划海外新店，并始终保持在正轨上。
